# montecarlo_looker_credentials (Data Source)

Looker credentials are an API key Monte Carlo stores for Looker connections to use. The client secret is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `api_client_id` (String) Client ID of the Looker API key.
- `base_url` (String) URL of the Looker API, such as https://acme.cloud.looker.com.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether to verify Looker's TLS certificate. Verified when left out. Null unless set.
